name: Texas Brigades Camps (Cadet)
city: Camps across Texas (Rising Star, La Pryor, McCoy, Freer, Santa Anna, Garwood, Anahuac)
what_you_do: Spend five days at a wildlife and land stewardship leadership camp. Past camps covered bobwhite quail, deer, bass, ranching, waterfowl and coastal wildlife.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 17, from incoming 8th graders to incoming seniors. Apply as a Cadet. Past camp graduates can later apply as Assistant Leaders.
pay_detail: Camp price not stated on the program pages. The site says tuition help is available. Email camps@texasbrigades.org.
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Nov 1, 2026 and close March 15, 2027. The 2026 camps ran June 7 to Aug 1, 2026.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application with two essay questions and a list of achievements. Rank your top three camp choices.
notes: Camp phone 210-556-1391. Assistant Leaders can earn college scholarships. Camps listed for 2026 include Bobwhite, Buckskin, Ranch, Bass, Waterfowl and Coastal Brigades.
